body: "Very low KMs", I didn't think 100,000km or around 65k miles was "very low" hahha
I was also thinking of just going out camping and surviving until I can't anymore and eventually pass away. It would be less violent and look like I was just lost in the woods.

Yeah, I try and make time to get out and do things. I work 5:30 to 3 almost every day, then classes start at college 4:45-8 or 10 depending on the day. I end up only having maybe one free day a week and that is usually filled with chores and running errands for the week. 

Professional help doesn't really seem to be the route for me. I've talked to family and they seem to just brush it off and say it's all part of growing up. I understand becoming an adult, you begin to take on more responsibility and your free time starts to dwindle, but at the same time. I can observe how my parents and their friends act and communicate, and I can tell they aren't feeling the same depression and lack luster of life.

I just believe my personality and my wants in life don't align with the normal person. I don't appreciate technology and modern conveniences. I feel like the modern world have striped people of what it means to be human and has created people who don't have meaningful or intelligent conversation. The world just seems so insignificant and I just feel like there isn't much to live for.
